author: ARKRaziel
quote: 13 years of waiting, 13 years of hype, and somehow Rockstar has managed to turn one of the most anticipated games in history into an absolute **** this point, GTA VI feels less like a video game and more like an endless marketing experiment to see how long they can keep millions of people waiting while delivering absolutely **** constant delays, the ridiculous secrecy, the complete lack of meaningful communication, and the endless hype are beyond pathetic. You would think that after making billions from GTA V, Rockstar could actually manage to release a sequel within a reasonable timeframe.Instead, we're supposed to celebrate every trailer like it's some kind of divine gift and thank Rockstar for the privilege of waiting another year.13 years. An entire generation has grown up waiting for this game. And the worst part is that people will still defend this nonsense like Rockstar is doing everyone a favor.Congratulations, Rockstar. You've mastered the art of selling hype instead of delivering games. Maybe GTA VII will be ready by 2050.**0/10. Absolutely ridiculous.**
